title: The Ache Is a Compass
subtitle: the unfinished thing, still pointing
mapEpigraph: The unfinished thing is still pointing.

prompts.text: Where does the ache live in the body?
How long has it been there?
What quiets it, and what sharpens it?
The thing that stays unfinished in me is… and it may be pointing toward…

blocks.title: The pocket compass
blocks.instruction: Carry one small object in your pocket. Each time your hand finds it, notice whether the ache has sharpened, softened, or moved.

blocks.closing: Keep the trace. Do not force a direction.
